title: Boulder School 2027: Machine Learning and Condensed Matter
institution: Boulder School for Condensed Matter and Materials Physics, University of Colorado Boulder
field: Condensed matter physics and machine learning
about: Boulder School 2027 on Machine Learning and Condensed Matter, 5-30 July 2027, introducing graduate students to the exchange of ideas between machine learning and many-body physics. Director: Leo Radzihovsky. The electronic application is open; deadline 15 January 2027.

upskill.name: Machine Learning - Foundations & Methods I

Description "the exchange of ideas between machine learning and many-body physics" → A001.01 "Unsupervised learning: clustering (k-means, DBSCAN), dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP)"
